evidence_limits: The platform receipt is evidence of remote project creation, binding names, owner-only visibility, and no deployment; the local build is evidence only for the uncustomized current starter. Neither proves a Saved Version, real-account, OAuth, email, Turnstile, D1 schema, R2 object, product UI, or production acceptance receipt.
The opaque project identifier is a linkage identifier, not a credential; no source-repository credential was requested, received, or recorded.
